mapper.sql: select id, resident_name, id_card, phone, screening_date, screening_location, screening_result, disease_type, handler, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from screening_outside
mapper.select:
and resident_name like concat('%', #{residentName}, '%') and id_card like concat('%', #{idCard}, '%') and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and screening_date = #{screeningDate} and screening_location like concat('%', #{screeningLocation}, '%') and screening_result like concat('%', #{screeningResult}, '%') and disease_type like concat('%', #{diseaseType}, '%') and handler like concat('%', #{handler}, '%')
order by id desc
